figurative_meaning_en: To provide for or support financially (especially dependents)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পাঁচটি সন্তান, সবাইকে পেট পালাতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: I have many mouths to feed.
He has to support five children financially.
note: Refers to the cultural emphasis on family sustenance in Bengali society
